data.overview: The fetched sources for Parfumdreams consist only of the retailer's own storefront navigation pages (homepages, an "Environment" page, and a "Vegan Beauty" category page), none of which contained substantive claim text beyond site menus. No independent evidence, legal matters, or verifiable brand-specific claims about safety, sustainability, cruelty-free, vegan, or labour practices could be extracted from the available source text.
